character: 'Mountain village' overlooking Arve valley with panoramic Mont Blanc views. Traditional Savoyard farming village. 7km gondola link to Megève. Unique church viewpoint. Quiet, local feel.
dining: Local Savoyard, pizzeria, mountain cuisine. Panoramic terraces with Mont Blanc views.
apres_scene: Quiet. Local bars. Shuttle to Megève.
activities_nearby: Portes du Mont Blanc lift pass with Megève. Via ferrata. Snowshoeing. 140km Evasion Mont Blanc linked area.
